statements.impact_statement: The affected DVB subtitle parser consumes WTV/video input, which is not a supported OCR document path. services/ocr/service.py verifies the decoded Pillow format matches the PNG/JPEG/TIFF suffix, and parses PDF with strict PdfReader before calling the engine. tests/test_ocr_service.py verifies real MPEG metadata renamed as PNG is rejected with HTTP 415 and the engine is never invoked; permitted still-image formats remain accepted. FFmpeg remains inventoried, not patched or removed. See docs/security-gates.md for the reviewed reachability boundary.

The affected CineForm HD decoder consumes AVI/video streams. The OCR service accepts only format-matched PNG/JPEG/TIFF and strictly parsed PDF, never video paths or URLs. Real-parser HTTP tests reject MPEG, GIF, PPM and JPEG disguised as PNG before any engine call, including Pillow-identifiable MPEG that verify() alone would accept. This is a reachability statement for this OCR boundary, not a claim that the transitive FFmpeg binary is fixed.

The vulnerable MPEG-PS muxing path is not called by still-image/PDF OCR; the service exposes no video encoding or stream muxing API. The explicit decoded-format allowlist and real-parser HTTP tests in tests/test_ocr_service.py ensure MPEG renamed with an allowed image extension cannot reach inference. Adding any video or encoding feature requires revisiting this statement; the vulnerable library remains in the full SBOM and scan inventory.

The affected DASH demuxer requires a live media manifest/stream. The OCR endpoint receives authenticated bounded bytes into a generated local file, accepts no input URL, rejects formats outside exact PNG/JPEG/TIFF matching or strict PDF, and has no DASH or media-stream path. tests/test_ocr_service.py exercises the real format parser before an engine call. The binary is not represented as fixed, and any future streaming support invalidates this statement.

The FFmpeg libraries are transitive OpenCV wheel components. The OCR boundary only accepts strictly preflighted PNG, JPEG, TIFF and PDF documents; video and audio containers, streams and codecs are rejected before inference.
Only validated still-image and PDF OCR paths are reachable; FFmpeg video and audio decoding paths are not exposed.
